result.summary: The page renders cleanly overall: header, search, category chips, promo banner, carousels, and bottom navigation are aligned and legible. The only findings are minor. The clipped last chip and carousel item and the cut-off pizza card were excluded as intentional scroll affordances.

issues.description: Secondary gray text (delivery fees such as '€2.40 delivery', the '(500+)' review count, and the '25–35 min' meta line) appears light gray on white, which may fall below the recommended 4.5:1 contrast ratio for small text.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text color to meet WCAG AA contrast for small text while keeping the visual hierarchy.

issues.description: The time badges (e.g., '15–25 min', '20–30 min') sit over the food photos with a semi-transparent white background, which slightly obscures the bottom edge of the images and makes the badge placement feel inconsistent with the '€0 delivery' and '-20%' badges placed at the top-left of the larger cards.
issues.suggestion: Standardize badge placement across card types, for example by placing all time and promo badges in the same corner of each card image.
